paragraphs: The Sprott School of Business at Carleton University is one of Canada's leading business schools, located in Ottawa, Ontario — Canada's capital city. AACSB-accredited and home to over 4,500 students, Sprott offers highly regarded undergraduate and graduate business programs including Bachelor of Commerce, Bachelor of International Business, MBA, and Master of Management Analytics.

Sprott's location in Ottawa provides students with unique access to Canada's federal government, Crown corporations, international organisations, and the technology companies of the 'Silicon Valley North' — Ottawa's thriving tech ecosystem. The school has strong co-op and experiential learning programs with Ottawa's top employers.

Ottawa is Canada's capital and one of the most educated cities in the country. The city offers a high quality of life, bilingual French-English environment, and lower cost of living than Toronto, while maintaining strong employment prospects for university graduates.

International students at Carleton benefit from the university's comprehensive international support services and access to Ottawa's government, technology, and non-profit sectors. Graduates qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit and Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program.
paragraphsRu: Sprott School of Business при Carleton University — один из ведущих бизнес-колледжей Канады в Оттаве, столице страны. Аккредитован AACSB, более 4 500 студентов.
Расположение в Оттаве открывает уникальный доступ к федеральному правительству Канады, международным организациям и технологическим компаниям «Silicon Valley North».
Оттава — столица Канады с высоким качеством жизни, двуязычной средой и более низкой стоимостью жизни, чем в Торонто.
Выпускники имеют право на Post-Graduation Work Permit и Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program.
